result.summary: Found 1 major issue: an untranslated localization key ('home_feed.popular_title') is rendered as a section heading instead of human-readable text. The rest of the page looks visually correct.

issues.description: Unlocalized string key 'home_feed.popular_title' is displayed as the section heading instead of translated text like 'Popular'.
issues.suggestion: Fix the localization lookup so the proper translated title renders instead of the raw i18n key.
